newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Fayette County, Ky..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Fayette County, Ky..

text.p: The Fayette County (Kentucky) School District Finance Corporation (the Corporation'') will, until the hour of 11:00 a.m., EST, on

receive in the office of Mr. Ernie Tacogue, Principal Assistant, District Support Services, Kentucky Department of Education, Room 1520, 15th Floor, Capital Plaza Tower, Frankfort, Kentucky 40601, sealed, competitive bids for the purchase of $17,710,000 (subject to adjustment) School Building Revenue Bonds, Series 1997A (the Bonds''). The Bonds are to be issued, subject to an approving legal opinion of Harper, Ferguson & Davis, Louisville, Kentucky, on a tax-exempt basis as described in the Preliminary Official Statement. The bidding conditions and terms of the offering are contained in the Official Terms and Conditions of Bond Sale, which, together with the Official Bid Form and Preliminary Official Statement, may be obtained from the Corporation's fiscal agent, J.J.B. Hilliard, W.L. Lyons, Inc., 501 South Fourth Avenue, Louisville, Kentucky 40202 (Telephone (502) 588-8639). The Preliminary Official
Statement is in a form deemed final'' by the Corporation for purposes of SEC Rule 15c2-12(b)(1), but is subject to revision, amendment and completion in a final Official Statement.
